font_stack: Segoe UI system-only, no webfonts — was src/styles.css L25, src/compact.css L26; now Bricolage Grotesque Variable + Manrope Variable + JetBrains Mono Variable via @fontsource (self-hosted, CSP-safe)

spacing: was no scale, ad-hoc px; now 4pt compact scale in tokens.css

csp_note: Tauri CSP allows 'self' only — external font CDNs are blocked; fonts are bundled via @fontsource variable packages
